diagnosis: Customer on Unified Auth asks how to reset their API token. Provide the scoped key rotation steps: create a new scoped key, switch traffic, then revoke the old key. No escalation needed.
reply: On accounts using Unified Auth, API credentials are managed as scoped keys. To reset your token, create a new scoped API key with the required scopes, update your integrations to use the new key, and once traffic is flowing, revoke the old key. Revocation takes effect immediately. For the full procedure, see our article on scoped API keys.
